SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Mag. c.]
Lenticular cataract (occasionally received Sulphur.).
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Mag. c.]
Heartburn ; belching ; eructations sour or greasy ; sour taste and sour vomiting.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Mag. c.]
Griping and rumbling in whole abdomen, followed by diarrhœa, thin and green, without tenesmus.
Diarrhœa ; preceded by cutting colic ; much wind in bowels.
Sour eructations ; whole child smells sour ; great thirst, especially evenings. θ Cholera infantum.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Mag. c.]
Menses flow more profusely during night, with dragging pains ; > on pressing on abdomen and on stooping.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Mag. c.]
Toothache during pregnancy, more during night.
   

NERVES. [36] [Mag. c.]
Pains : neuralgic, lightning-like, < left side ; insupportable during repose, must get up and walk about.
Sensation of being tired, especially in feet and when sitting ; aching, restless.
Disposed to neuralgia.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Mag. c.]
Unrefreshing sleep, more tired in morning than when lying down in evening.
   

FEVER. [40] [Mag. c.]
Great internal heat, at night, restless, aversion to uncovering.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Mag. c.]
Adapted to persons, especially children, of irritable disposition, nervous temperament ; lax fibre ; sour smell.
